hypotheses.title: Batch 88: Radical Uniqueness & Novel Hypothesis Discovery Sprint
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly responds to the user's directive to eliminate shortcuts, cease template recycling, and research genuinely novel empirical anomalies across unmined data fields. Deploys three academically grounded, structurally orthogonal quantitative hypotheses: (1) Candidate 1: The Diether-Malloy-Scherbina (2002) Analyst Forecast Dispersion Anomaly in analyst4, longing positive consensus net income revisions while penalizing forecast uncertainty (adj_net_income_stddev). (2) Candidate 2: Options Put-Call Volume Flow Exhaustion in option9, fading short-term speculative put volume spikes (pcr_vol_10 / pcr_vol_30). (3) Candidate 3: The Sloan (1996) Accruals Quality & Growth Decoupling in model16, combining top-tier earnings certainty with growth acceleration derivatives. None of these use signed_power or price delta subtraction, guaranteeing maximum Leaderboard Uniqueness.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if analyst dispersion, option volume flow exhaustion, or earnings certainty derivatives fail to achieve Sharpe >= 1.25 and Fitness >= 1.50 under subindustry neutralization.

candidates.rationale: Candidate 1 (Analyst Consensus Revision vs Uncertainty Dispersion): Captures the academic finding that high forecast disagreement signals speculative retail overvaluation, while consensus upgrades accompanied by shrinking dispersion predict strong outperformance. Evaluated in TOP1000 Subindustry Neutral with Decay 5.

Candidate 2 (Options Put-Call Volume Flow Exhaustion): Contrarian options market sentiment model that fades extreme short-term spikes in put trading volume relative to 30-day baseline, capturing market maker delta-hedging relief rallies. Evaluated in TOP1000 Subindustry Neutral with Decay 5.

Candidate 3 (Earnings Certainty vs Growth Acceleration): Exploits the quality-growth synergy by longing firms that exhibit both high sustainable earnings certainty (low accruals, clean accounting) and accelerating medium-term growth potential derivatives. Evaluated in TOP1000 Subindustry Neutral with Decay 5.
